# Get Date From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets the dates from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getDateFrom(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getDateFrom(input: I will see you Monday the 14th)
~~~~
